scope: All methods declared by the pinned app-server protocol registries, including legacy, experimental, and internal entries; transport and capability controls below. This is not the entire Codex CLI, model API, or MCP protocol.

status_definitions.supported: Exported or automatic behavior implemented for this slice; test and live evidence are independently recorded.
status_definitions.partial: Only the explicitly stated subset is implemented.
status_definitions.unsupported: No certified SDK workflow. Raw invocation or generated type availability does not change this status.

controls.name: rpc-envelope
controls.description: One request, response, error, or notification object. No jsonrpc member is emitted. Batch messages are not supported.

controls.name: rpc-id-string-or-i64
controls.description: Exact tagged string and signed 64-bit integer identifiers. Null, fractional, out-of-range, or malformed IDs are rejected.

controls.name: rpc-error
controls.description: Preserve error code, message, and optional data without retry. Remote security exception: reflected explicitly supplied bearer credentials are redacted from diagnostic message/data/raw errors; affected raw JSON may be re-encoded. Unaffected raw errors, native error code and correlation remain unchanged.

controls.name: request-trace-context
controls.description: Optional top-level trace field exists upstream; no caller-facing request trace option in this slice.

controls.name: notification-emittedAtMs
controls.description: Optional server notification envelope emission timestamp; local Event exposes method and raw params, not envelope-level timestamps.

controls.name: stdio-json-lines
controls.description: One JSON envelope per newline-delimited stdin/stdout frame; blank-line handling is transport-specific. SDK applies finite frame limits.

controls.name: stdio-eof-and-owned-process-shutdown
controls.description: SDK closes owned stdin, waits a bounded grace period, then kills and reaps only its child. No guarantee that an arbitrary descendant process exits.

controls.name: websocket-text-message
controls.description: NewRemote opens WS/WSS with explicit bearer-header authentication, verified TLS and fresh initialize/initialized. Exactly one JSON envelope per complete text message; no JSONL delimiter or batch. URL credentials/query/fragment, redirects, disabled TLS verification and ambient proxies are rejected/unused; non-loopback plaintext requires opt-in. Finite payload bounds and no reconnect/replay.

controls.name: websocket-ping
controls.description: WebSocket library automatically replies to received Ping with its matching Pong payload while the SDK reader is active; no application heartbeat or ping API.

controls.name: websocket-pong
controls.description: WebSocket control Pong is handled by the transport and never delivered as a JSON protocol event.

controls.name: websocket-close
controls.description: Received Close terminates this connection. Client Close releases only its socket and pending work, without service shutdown, process termination, reconnect or replay.

controls.name: websocket-binary
controls.description: No binary protocol or binary-message API. Official server drops unsupported inbound binary messages; this SDK rejects received binary data with an explicit terminal ErrProtocol instead of silently discarding it.

controls.name: unix-websocket-control-socket
controls.description: Official local control socket accepts WebSocket upgrades, not a raw JSONL stream.

controls.name: managed-daemon-shutdown
controls.description: Separate /daemon/shutdown WebSocket endpoint on managed local control sockets; PID-text handshake outside JSON-RPC. Never emitted by SDK Close.

controls.name: remote-control-tunnel
controls.description: Official remote-control transport and pairing workflows are outside this SDK slice. Named RPCs are separately inventoried.

controls.name: in-process-typed-channels
controls.description: Official embedded Rust facade uses typed in-memory channels. This Go SDK does not embed the runtime.

controls.name: server-request-resolution
controls.description: serverRequest/resolved matches native threadId and exact tagged requestId to an unanswered handle. Local Cancel and expiry send nothing; an admitted response cannot be retracted. No invented cancellation method or success inference.

controls.name: initialize-experimental-api
controls.description: The native initialize capability can be encoded; experimental workflow support must be checked per method and field.

controls.name: initialize-notification-opt-out
controls.description: Native optOutNotificationMethods can be encoded; actual server filtering has not been live-validated.

controls.name: initialize-extensions
controls.description: Native extensions metadata can be encoded; no extension behavior is certified.

controls.name: initialize-request-attestation
controls.description: Native flag and raw attestation/generate request/answer transport exist, but no attestation implementation or certified workflow. Do not enable without a caller-provided compatible implementation.

controls.name: initialize-form-elicitation
controls.description: Native capability fields and raw request/answer transport exist, but typed elicitation and its interactive workflow are not certified.

controls.name: initialize-explicit-gateway-oauth
controls.description: Native flag exists; login and account-management workflows are unsupported.

controls.name: sdk-managed-direct-child-observation
controls.description: SubscribeTree: recursive native parent/source and completed collab relations, ancestor-first bounded pending delivery, explicit unresolved scope, conflict/cycle diagnostics and bounded terminal item identity deduplication. Live spawn confirms SDK-derived creation once across turns; no-ID deltas remain distinct. Existing native broadcast, exact envelopes and per-observer data retained. No child resume/start/subscribe RPC or extra connection. Best-effort server auto-attach is runtime-unverified. Explicit bounded native Thread history seeds establish history Associated only, never creation or current work state. Parent/child status and observation lifetime remain independent. Disconnect retains queued events and a reserved disconnected/permanent-gap record; new Clients have fresh epochs and no replay cache continuity. Cold-thread recovery and replay remain unverified; no automatic recovery RPCs. See ../compatibility.md#managed-direct-child-observation-ticket-01 for separate server E1 source evidence and limits. Atomic fanout admission and original reverse-request authority are verified in ticket04; per-capability E1/E2 contract and runnable synthetic example are published in ../subagent-compatibility.md. ACP draft stability and live passes are not claimed; raw-only notifications remain raw-only.
